abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of The Dread Mace is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: RAMPAGING DESTRUCTION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects: Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilities.name: THE END OF EMPIRES
abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly DESTRUCTION units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: THE SHIELD INVIOLATE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.

abilities.name: AVATAR OF DESTRUCTION
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it ( ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: ON A TEAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WILD ENTHUSIASM
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: This unit can use the ‘ Power Through ’ command even if it has not charged this turn. In addition, when you pick a target for that command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than this unit.

abilities.name: DA FINAL FLING
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: While this unit is not in combat, each time a model in this unit is slain by a shooting attack and that model was within 12" of the attacking unit, roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if the attacking unit was a MONSTER . On a 4+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the SHOOT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: AIM FER ITS EYES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If all of the attacks made with this unit’s Stinga Bows this turn targeted the same enemy unit, pick that enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a BEAST or CAVALRY unit, or add 2 to the roll if the target is a MONSTER . On a 4+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s Companion weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MORBOY FURY
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: THE SAVAGE HORDES
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Add 10 to the control score of this unit while it is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn.

abilities.name: HEDKRAKKA, GOB OF GORK
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: While this unit’s Hedkrakka, Gob of Gork , is on the battlefield, it has WIZARD ( 1 ) .

abilities.name: GO FOR DA EYES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit’s Dakko Sharp-Stikka is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a MONSTER . On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown finishes a charge move, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 1" of that unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. If that enemy unit is INFANTRY , add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any).

abilities.name: PULLIN’ AHEAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn and has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move D6". It must end that move in combat. Then, add 1 to the target’s momentum points . After this ability has been resolved, the target cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BOMBZ AWAY, LADZ!
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Friendly units in this Regiment of Renown can use RUN abilities and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn while they are wholly within 12" of this Regiment of Renown’s Swampboss Skumdrekk .

abilities.name: SNATCH ’EM UP!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this Regiment of Renown ’s Swampboss Skumdrekk to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: AN EYE FOR LOOT
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown .
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve studying the battlefield . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: SWOOP IN

abilities.declare: Pick the Grundstok Gunhauler in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is studying the battlefield .
abilities.effect: Set up the Grundstok Gunhauler on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units that have an artefact of power and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 3" of the Grundstok Gunhauler and more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SNEAKY DISTRACTION

abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: SUPER-SECRET TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in a super-secret tunnel . It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: SUDDEN EMERGENCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If the Rabble-Rowza in this Regiment of Renown is in a super-secret tunnel , pick it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other friendly units that are in a super-secret tunnel within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: GOROAN FORGECRAFT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DESTRUCTION HERO that is within the combat range of a HERO in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: BELLOW OF GORKAMORKA
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Ogroid Thaumaturge in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn. In addition, while the target has the BURNING keyword, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown .
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: If a friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat .

abilities.name: GO DAT WAY!
abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is within 12" of the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can still use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: TAKTIKAL COWERING
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: While the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown: That Loonboss has WARD ( 4+ ) . Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Loonboss , allocate 1 damage point to that Dankhold Troggoth after the damage sequence for that Loonboss has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: PROJECTILE VOMIT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick all other units (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BELLOWING MOCKERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’RE YOU LOOKIN’ AT?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.
